t1n254sb.baseName: COSTWAY 6FT Artificial Christmas Tree with Metal Stand - White
t1n254sb.variantName: COSTWAY 6FT Artificial Christmas Tree with Metal Stand - White
t1n254sb.sourceDescription: Are you looking forward to the upcoming winter season? This white Christmas tree is a great decoration to create a festive atmosphere! The Christmas tree features a collapsible design, which means the branches are attached directly to the tree, making it easier for you to assemble your tree with less effort. This artificial Christmas tree features 350/ 650/ 950/ 1138 beautiful tips that give it a full and realistic look. The sturdy metal stand and PVC plastic leaves are suitable for long-lasting use and allow you to place it indoors or outdoors, such as in a shop, office, living room, balcony or porch. Make your Christmas dream come true on any occasion! Elegant White Christmas Tree: This Christmas tree is pure white, which stands out from the traditional green Christmas trees. This elegant Christmas tree makes a beautiful backdrop for a winter wonderland. It suits both indoor and outdoor spaces and adds more excitement to your life. Flame-resistant and fluffy branches: The leaves of this Christmas tree are made of high-quality PVC material, flame retardant and odourless for unforgettable Christmas with peace of mind and joy. With 350/ 650/ 950/ 1138 branch tips that make the tree look more real and full, the Christmas tree mimics a full fir tree for a lively look. Easy to set up and store: It only takes a few minutes to set up and take down the Christmas tree, saving you time and effort. The collapsible composition can not only expand easily and makes the branches fluffy and lush. The Christmas tree can also be disassembled into several foldable parts for easy storage. Solid Metal Base: Thanks to the upright tree style in a lightweight size, the sturdy metal base is provided to give greater support. The metal base is designed to keep the tree stand tall and from tipping and tripping over the years. The plastic feet add stability and prevent scratches on the floor. Great Holiday Decoration: The artificial Christmas tree has a charming white color to give you romantic winter feelings. You can decorate the branches with Christmas ornaments as you like to spend quality time with your family and create great memories. It creates a festive atmosphere for Halloween, weddings, Valentine's Day, Christmas and other occasions. Specifications: Colour: White Material: PVC, metal From 5 ft to 8 ft Tree height: 150 cm/ 180 cm/ 210 cm/ 240cm Number of tips: 350/ 650/ 950/ 1138 Net weight: 2 kg/ 3 kg/ 4.5 kg/ 5.5 kg Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Is Assembly Required: Yes Package includes: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Instruction manual Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL
